issue.summary: On the Web/Desktop client, when a user composes a single message that mixes plain text with Teamily artifact links (https://teamily.ai/docs/<id>), the message that lands in the conversation is not in the order the user typed. The content is re-arranged on send, so a line of explanatory text can end up separated from the artifact link it was written to introduce. Because these messages are typically structured as 'heading → link → heading → link', any reordering silently re-pairs each heading with the wrong artifact, which changes the meaning of the message. The reporter (Shawn) explicitly asks whether the original input order should be preserved — i.e. this is reported as a defect against the expected behaviour that a sent message reads exactly as it was typed.
steps: Open any conversation on the Web/Desktop client.
In the composer, type content in a deliberate order, e.g. text A → Teamily artifact link (https://teamily.ai/docs/<id>) → text B → a second artifact link.
Compare the order of the blocks in the composer before sending with the order rendered in the sent message bubble.
issue.expected: The sent message renders the blocks in exactly the order the user typed them: text A, then its artifact link, then text B, then its artifact link. Each artifact link stays attached to the text that introduces it.
issue.actual: The blocks are re-arranged after sending, so the rendered order no longer matches the input order. The reporter's screenshot shows the sent message as a flat sequence of text lines and plain green underlined links; the pairing between each heading and its artifact link is not preserved as typed.

understanding.subject: Web/桌面端输入框里混排的一条消息：文字 A + Teamily 文档链接（https://teamily.ai/docs/<id>）+ 文字 B + 第二个文档链接
understanding.trigger: 在输入框里按上述顺序键入这些内容后点发送
understanding.phenomenon: 发送后的消息气泡里各内容块被重新排列，顺序与输入顺序不一致，标题与它对应的文档链接被拆开（截图中呈「一串文字行 + 一串平铺链接」）
understanding.expected: 气泡严格按输入顺序渲染：文字 A、其文档链接、文字 B、其文档链接，每个链接紧跟介绍它的那段文字

oracle.hit: 发送后气泡里「文字块 → 其文档链接」的两处相邻关系不成立（两块文字被并到一起、两个链接被挪到文字之后或之前），即渲染顺序与键入顺序 AA→链接a→BB→链接b 不一致
oracle.normal: 发送后气泡自上而下依次是「AA-blk 这是第一个标题」「https://teamily.ai/docs/eval2734a」「BB-blk 这是第二个标题」「https://teamily.ai/docs/eval2734b」，跨块正则匹配成功，checks[0] 的视觉问题回答「是」
oracle.canFail: 有毛病时（发送时按内容类型重新分段、或渲染层把链接块提升），气泡变成「AA…」「BB…」「链接a」「链接b」的平铺顺序，正则要求的两处「文字后紧跟其自己的链接」不再成立 → 检查失败；checks[0] 的视觉问题同样回答「否」
oracle.baseline: 每轮触发前输入框为空：baseline[0] 要求 chat.composer 存在，baseline[1] 要求输入框区域内没有 AA-blk；任一不成立判本轮偏离，不计有效尝试

quotes.text: On the Web/Desktop client, when a user composes a single message that mixes plain text with Teamily artifact links (https://teamily.ai/docs/<id>), the message that lands in the conversation is not in the order the user typed.
Because these messages are typically structured as 'heading → link → heading → link', any reordering silently re-pairs each heading with the wrong artifact, which changes the meaning of the message.
Open any conversation on the Web/Desktop client.
In the composer, type content in a deliberate order, e.g. text A → Teamily artifact link (https://teamily.ai/docs/<id>) → text B → a second artifact link.
Send the message.
Compare the order of the blocks in the composer before sending with the order rendered in the sent message bubble.
The sent message renders the blocks in exactly the order the user typed them: text A, then its artifact link, then text B, then its artifact link.
The blocks are re-arranged after sending, so the rendered order no longer matches the input order.
The reporter's screenshot shows the sent message as a flat sequence of text lines and plain green underlined links; the pairing between each heading and its artifact link is not preserved as typed.
Web / Desktop (screenshot captured on the Web client)
**Frequency**: To be confirmed — the reporter did not state a reproduction rate

oracle.hit: 对照组的顺序检查失败（两段纯文字在发送后也被调换顺序）——说明顺序观察本身不可靠，或缺陷范围比 Issue 描述的更广
oracle.normal: 两段纯文字按键入顺序渲染，跨块正则与视觉判定都通过；对照组通过才能证明主用例的检查在正常时不会误报
oracle.canFail: 如果检查在纯文字上也失败，主用例的命中就不能归因于「文字与 artifact 链接混排」，需要按证据修订观察方式

selfCheck.R1: ok：动作只用 type / node，元素只用 chat.composer 与 region chat/composer（取自 REGIONS）和 element:chat.composer（region 的 element: 形式），没有坐标与代码
selfCheck.R2: ok：对象是「在允许清单会话里自己键入的一条混排消息」，targets.conv 的 must.contains=黄悦龙 与 guidance/允许清单一致；正文块与链接内容由本用例键入，understanding.subject 与之一致
selfCheck.R3: ok：触发就是 Issue 的第 3 步「发送该消息」（actions[1] = teamily.tapSend），前面只有键入动作，没有用下游操作代替触发
selfCheck.R4: ok：现象发生在发送这一步，actions[1]（tapSend）自带 expect(role: phenomenon)，oracle.at 指向 actions[1]；checks[0] 用视觉对同一现象做补充判定
selfCheck.R5: ok：①有毛病时（按类型重新分段/链接块提升）两处「文字后紧跟其链接」的相邻关系消失，跨块正则不再成立；②范围取最窄，先按 {message: AA-blk} 锚到目标气泡，只在视觉判定用整屏；③匹配内容是本次键入的消息正文，不是发送界面自带的文字；④发送留存的只有消息本身，输入框状态写进 baseline（输入框为空、无 AA-blk）
selfCheck.R6: ok：afterCheck 用 teamily.clearComposer 复位输入框，并带 expect(role: precondition) 确认已清空；已发送的消息无法撤回（发到允许清单会话，属允许的数据构造），在 risks 中说明
selfCheck.R7: ok：Issue 没有给出明确对照（understanding.control 为空），额外加 control 子用例「只排两段纯文字」，用来证明顺序观察在正常时会通过
selfCheck.R8: ok：所需积木都存在（type、teamily.openConversation/tapSend/clearComposer、text/visual-region/ai 观察），missing 为空
selfCheck.R9: ok：执行端 desktop-web 与 Issue 的 Web/Desktop 一致，没有替代执行
selfCheck.R10: ok：循环里只用 phase: any 的 Node（openConversation / tapSend / clearComposer）；不发 prepare-only Node；消息只发到允许清单会话「黄悦龙Aaron, 黄悦龙-AgentEval, aaron+test2」；delayAfterMs 均 ≤ 1000
selfCheck.R11: ok：标题「输入框混排「文字A→文档链接→文字B→文档链接」发送后：气泡是否保持输入顺序」写的是本 Issue 的对象与现象
selfCheck.R12: ok：每个目标、动作、检查、expect 都在 trace 里引用了片段编号或 executor:<理由>；quotes 全部逐字取自原文

risks: 多行内容依赖 type 把「\n」按换行写进 Web 输入框：如果输入框把换行当成发送、或吃掉换行，actions[0] 的 expect 会偏离，需要改成逐行键入（key）后再发送。
跨块正则依赖 text 观察把气泡内各块按渲染顺序拼成一段可匹配的文字：如果观察按节点逐条匹配而不拼接，这条检查会恒不通过（假命中），此时以 checks[0] 的视觉回答为准并修订观察方式。
用例里的文档链接 id（eval2734a / eval2734b）是合成的：按 Issue 描述链接只作普通绿色下划线渲染，检查只看文本；若客户端对不存在的文档 id 不输出链接文本，需要换成真实文档链接。
同一会话多轮会累积内容相同的消息，scope {message: "AA-blk"} 可能锚到上一轮的气泡；判定以最下方最新消息为准，必要时在轮间刷新会话或给内容加轮号。
复现率未知（Issue 未给出），首轮命中后仍需多轮统计有效尝试次数与命中区间。
